list_child.name: list_ledger_claims
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of expense claims currently held in the claims ledger. This is the record finance works from when processing reimbursements.

decoys.name: list_audit_claims
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of expense claims currently held in the audit sample. This is the record internal audit works from when testing compliance.

decoys.name: list_archive_claims
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of expense claims currently held in the prior-year archive. This is the record tax staff work from when answering filing queries.

decoys.name: list_card_claims
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of expense claims currently held in the corporate card feed. This is the record accounts payable works from when reconciling statements.

get_child.name: get_claim_record
get_child.desc: Look up the full record of a single expense claim using its unique identifier. Returns every field as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_claim_receipts
decoys.desc: Look up the receipt images of a single expense claim using its unique identifier. Returns every attachment as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_claim_approvals
decoys.desc: Look up the approval trail of a single expense claim using its unique identifier. Returns every sign-off as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_claim_postings
decoys.desc: Look up the ledger postings of a single expense claim using its unique identifier. Returns every journal line as currently stored.

list_parent.name: list_payee_employees
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of employees in the payee directory. This is the list payroll uses when paying out approved expense claims.

decoys.name: list_card_employees
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of employees in the corporate card program. This is the list the card provider uses when issuing monthly statements.

decoys.name: list_travel_employees
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of employees in the travel booking tool. This is the list the travel agency uses when booking flights and hotels.

decoys.name: list_approver_employees
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of employees in the approval hierarchy. This is the list the workflow uses when routing claims for sign-off.

get_parent.name: get_employee_profile
get_parent.desc: Look up the full profile of a single employee using its unique identifier. Returns every field as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_employee_banking
decoys.desc: Look up the bank details of a single employee using its unique identifier. Returns the payout account as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_employee_limits
decoys.desc: Look up the spending limits of a single employee using its unique identifier. Returns each policy cap as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_employee_card
decoys.desc: Look up the corporate card of a single employee using its unique identifier. Returns the card account as currently stored.

delete_child.name: delete_expense_claim
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase an expense claim from the system, removing it from all reports and totals. This action cannot be undone once performed.

decoys.name: reverse_claim_payout
decoys.desc: Permanently reverse the payout on an expense claim, pulling the money back from the employee's account. This action cannot be undone once performed.

decoys.name: void_expense_claim
decoys.desc: Permanently void an expense claim as fraudulent, locking it against any further payment. This action cannot be undone once performed.

decoys.name: purge_claim_receipts
decoys.desc: Permanently erase the receipt images on an expense claim, removing them from all audit files. This action cannot be undone once performed.

set_enum.name: set_claim_review_status
set_enum.desc: Update the review status of an expense claim to reflect where it stands in the approval workflow. Valid statuses are submitted, approved, reimbursed, and denied.

decoys.name: set_claim_audit_status
decoys.desc: Update the audit status of an expense claim to reflect where it stands in the compliance review. Valid statuses are submitted, approved, reimbursed, and denied.

decoys.name: set_claim_forecast_status
decoys.desc: Update the forecast status of an expense claim to reflect where it should stand at month-end close. Valid statuses are submitted, approved, reimbursed, and denied.

decoys.name: set_claim_portal_status
decoys.desc: Update the portal status of an expense claim to reflect what the claimant sees online. Valid statuses are submitted, approved, reimbursed, and denied.

set_bool.name: flag_policy_exception
set_bool.desc: Mark an expense claim as requiring a policy exception because it falls outside normal reimbursement limits. This is typically used when a manager grants a special allowance.

decoys.name: flag_missing_receipt
decoys.desc: Mark an expense claim as missing its receipt because the original was lost or damaged. This is typically used when a signed affidavit replaces the paper slip.

decoys.name: flag_client_billable
decoys.desc: Mark an expense claim as billable to a client because it was incurred on a client engagement. This is typically used when the cost is recharged on the next invoice.

decoys.name: flag_taxable_benefit
decoys.desc: Mark an expense claim as a taxable benefit because it counts as income for the employee. This is typically used when payroll must report the amount on a payslip.

set_ref.name: reassign_expense_claim
set_ref.desc: Move an expense claim onto a different employee's account, correcting cases where the claim was filed under the wrong person. This is used to fix misattributed submissions.

decoys.name: route_expense_claim
decoys.desc: Route an expense claim to a different employee for approval, sending it to the manager who should sign it off. This is used when the default approver is away.

decoys.name: charge_expense_claim
decoys.desc: Charge an expense claim to a different employee's cost centre, recording whose budget pays for it. This is used when one person travels on behalf of another team.

decoys.name: escalate_expense_claim
decoys.desc: Escalate an expense claim to a different employee for audit review, handing it to the auditor who should examine it. This is used when a claim needs a second opinion.

send.name: email_employee
send.desc: Send an email notification to an employee regarding their expense claims. Use this to communicate status changes or general updates.
child_verbs: follow up by email with the employee behind {obj}

decoys.name: remit_employee
decoys.desc: Send a remittance advice to an employee regarding their expense claims. Use this to confirm the amount and date of a reimbursement.
child_verbs: send a remittance advice to the employee behind {obj}
send the employee behind {obj} their remittance

decoys.name: chase_employee
decoys.desc: Send a receipt chaser to an employee regarding their expense claims. Use this to collect missing receipts before the audit deadline.
child_verbs: chase the employee behind {obj} for receipts
ask the employee behind {obj} for the missing receipts

decoys.name: remind_employee
decoys.desc: Send a policy reminder to an employee regarding their expense claims. Use this to point them to the rules their claims must follow.
child_verbs: remind the employee behind {obj} of the expense policy
send the employee behind {obj} a policy reminder

create.name: create_expense_claim
create.desc: Create a new expense claim on behalf of an employee, with an optional purpose and starting status. This is used when finance enters a claim for someone.

decoys.name: create_cash_advance
decoys.desc: Create a new cash advance on behalf of an employee, with an optional purpose and starting status. This is used when someone needs funds before a trip.

decoys.name: create_travel_request
decoys.desc: Create a new travel request on behalf of an employee, with an optional purpose and starting status. This is used when a trip needs approval before booking.

decoys.name: create_card_dispute
decoys.desc: Create a new card dispute on behalf of an employee, with an optional purpose and starting status. This is used when a corporate card charge looks wrong.

list_notes.name: list_claim_notes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the notes attached to a single expense claim. This includes every remark left by reviewers and the claimant.

decoys.name: list_claim_receipts
decoys.desc: Retrieve the receipts attached to a single expense claim. This includes every image and file uploaded by the claimant.

decoys.name: list_claim_approvals
decoys.desc: Retrieve the approvals attached to a single expense claim. This includes every sign-off recorded by managers and finance.

decoys.name: list_claim_postings
decoys.desc: Retrieve the ledger postings attached to a single expense claim. This includes every journal line booked by accounts payable.

add_note.name: add_claim_note
add_note.desc: Attach a new note to an expense claim, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks from reviewers or the claimant.

decoys.name: add_claim_receipt
decoys.desc: Attach a new receipt to an expense claim, with an optional title. This is used to record proof of purchase from the claimant.

decoys.name: add_claim_query
decoys.desc: Attach a new audit query to an expense claim, with an optional title. This is used to record questions raised by internal audit.

decoys.name: add_claim_mileage
decoys.desc: Attach a new mileage entry to an expense claim, with an optional title. This is used to record distances driven on company business.

update_note.name: edit_claim_note
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on an expense claim. This is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been saved.

decoys.name: reply_claim_note
decoys.desc: Post a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on an expense claim. This is used when a reviewer answers a remark left by the claimant.

decoys.name: resolve_claim_note
decoys.desc: Close out an existing note on an expense claim with resolution text and an optional title. This is used once the question it raised has been settled.

decoys.name: countersign_claim_note
decoys.desc: Countersign an existing note on an expense claim with an approver's comment and an optional title. This is used to confirm a remark before the claim is paid.

delete_note.name: delete_claim_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a note from an expense claim. The note is erased from the claim record for good.

decoys.name: redact_claim_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redact the text of a note on an expense claim. The wording is blacked out on the claim record for good.

decoys.name: strip_claim_note
decoys.desc: Permanently strip the attachments from a note on an expense claim. The files are erased from the claim record for good.

decoys.name: seal_claim_note
decoys.desc: Permanently seal a note on an expense claim from the claimant's view. The note is hidden on the claim record for good.

set_image.name: set_claim_image
set_image.desc: Set the cover image shown on an expense claim record. It is typically a thumbnail picked to identify the trip or event.

decoys.name: set_claim_receipt
decoys.desc: Set the receipt scan shown on an expense claim record. It is typically a phone capture of the till slip from the purchase.

decoys.name: set_claim_route
decoys.desc: Set the route plan shown on an expense claim record. It is typically the driving route for a mileage reimbursement.

decoys.name: set_claim_signature
decoys.desc: Set the signature image shown on an expense claim record. It is typically the claimant's scanned signature on the declaration.

writer.name: write_message
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the expense claims it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_memo
decoys.desc: Write an audit memo from a brief, which states the finding in the auditor's own words, and the expense claims it should cite. It returns the finished memo.

decoys.name: write_accrual
decoys.desc: Write a month-end accrual summary from a brief, which states the position in the controller's own words, and the expense claims it should include. It returns the finished summary.

decoys.name: write_rejection
decoys.desc: Write a claim rejection letter from a brief, which states the reason in the reviewer's own words, and the expense claims it should cover. It returns the finished letter.

image.name: generate_image
image.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the result.

decoys.name: generate_infographic
decoys.desc: Generate a policy infographic from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the graphic.

decoys.name: generate_banner
decoys.desc: Generate an intranet banner from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the banner.

decoys.name: generate_stamp
decoys.desc: Generate an approval stamp from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the stamp.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: Search the help docs and knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to learn how the expense system works.

decoys.name: search_policy
decoys.desc: Search the travel and expense policy with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to check what the company will reimburse.

decoys.name: search_tax
decoys.desc: Search the tax guidance library with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to check how a benefit must be reported.

decoys.name: search_rates
decoys.desc: Search the per diem rate tables with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to check the daily allowance for a city.
